name: Boothbay Harbor
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Boothbay Harbor?
answer_short: Street-legal LSVs yes, plain golf carts no. In Boothbay Harbor, a registered LSV may use a road posted 35 mph or less and may cross a faster road at an intersection. Plain golf carts are not road-legal on the mainland.

golf_cart.notes: Mainland golf carts are not road-legal

lsv.notes: Registered. The town can still close a road for safety.

rules.rule: A low-speed vehicle may be operated only on a road posted 35 mph or less, and may cross a faster road at an intersection.
A golf cart registration for public roads is limited to islands that have no state-maintained roads.

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Boothbay Harbor?
faq.a: Roads posted 35 mph or less. Registered. The town can still close a road for safety. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a regular golf cart in Boothbay Harbor?
faq.a: No. Maine limits that registration to islands without state roads.

faq.q: Where can I drive an LSV in Boothbay Harbor?
faq.a: On roads posted 35 mph or less. Cross a faster road only at an intersection.
